designationHistory.name: Lake Isom Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Lake Isom Migratory Waterfowl Refuge in Lake and Obion Counties, Tennessee, by Executive Order 7953.
designationHistory.note: A 2021 FWS compatibility determination (ServCat 136590) gives 'May 10, 1935' as the date established; that conflicts with the order itself and was not adopted. The 1935 date may reflect an earlier acquisition step (not verified).
